title: Sanger Tree of Life Sample Preparation: Triage and Dissection
author: Jessie Jay
materials: Select the first sample from the cold rack.

steps.title: Inspect and Triage Sample
steps.instruction: Inspect the sample and determine the preservation method to decide the processing path.

substeps.instruction: For snap frozen ('standard') samples, proceed to weighing and dissection.
For non-snap frozen ('non-standard') samples, follow the specific preservative or blood handling steps.

steps.title: Determine Required Sample Amount
steps.instruction: Decide the amount of sample required for the desired downstream process based on Table 1 or the relevant Decision Making Tree in Appendices.

steps.title: Weigh and Dissect Sample
steps.instruction: Use an analytical scale and pre-chilled tools to isolate the required sample weight.

substeps.instruction: Tare a new clean weighing boat using an analytical scale.
Use clean, pre-chilled dissection tools (scalpel, tweezers, scissors) and a metal dissection block to cut the sample to the desired weight.
Place the prepared sample into the correct destination container.
Return any remaining tissue to the original container.
Clean tools and dissection block with Azowipe tissue and bury them in dry ice for the next sample.

steps.title: Select Homogenization Protocol
steps.instruction: Choose the homogenization method based on the total sample weight and taxonomic group.

substeps.instruction: If total weight is 25 mg or less and from Metazoa (excluding sponges and corals), use the 'Sanger Tree of Life Sample Homogenisation: PowerMash' protocol.
If total weight is greater than 25 mg for all taxonomic groups, use the 'Sanger Tree of Life Sample Homogenisation: Covaris cryoPREP® Automated Dry Pulverizer' protocol.

steps.title: Process Samples in Preservative Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare samples stored in preservative solutions for processing as frozen tissue.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube in wet ice to allow the liquid to defrost.
Remove the sample from the solution and transfer it to a new tube.
Dispose of the preservative solution in an appropriate waste container.
Proceed to the weighing and dissection steps (noting that recorded weight will be inaccurate due to absorbed solution).

steps.title: Process Blood Samples
steps.instruction: Prepare blood samples for downstream protocols.

substeps.instruction: Defrost the sample on wet ice.
Aliquot the required amount for the desired downstream protocol.
If blood is stored in ethanol, take the aliquot from underneath the ethanol layer.
